annotations.text:
Petrol base (#070C0F) replaces the old neutral grey.
All tokens lifted from theme.css + tailwind.config.js —
Outfit / Inter / JetBrains Mono, 16px card + 10px block radii.

Backtest figures are REAL — the short_vol run from this
session: 74 trades, 70.3% win, +Rs23,991, PF 1.40.
Home screen uses realistic sample fills.

The 'How it works' panel answers what the tab never did:
needs order flow?, direction, trigger, filters, sizing, exit.
Copy comes from the strategy class, not the UI.
